releases.notes: First release. Finds byte-identical duplicate samples across your kits and stages removals so nothing is deleted outright.
changes: Scans a sample library and finds duplicates by file contents, not filenames
Search by sample name, and sort by space reclaimable, copy count or file size
Play any copy before deciding, with the suggested keep marked
Removals staged in quarantine and restorable; permanent deletion is a separate action
